Source https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/titan/
OUT OF REACH uses an adapted excerpt as its opening music (loading, launch and ascent):
continuous source passage 48 to 132 seconds, gradual gain staging, added original low percussion
and quiet tonal vibration by the OUT OF REACH team, mastering. In game it is faded at the
section ends; it is not looped.
